verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an Auditor API that lets audit firms 'programmatically conduct audits in Vanta'. Auditors can list the audits assigned to their firm, pull controls and evidence, manage information requests, and review the resources in scope for each engagement. Marketing also says Vanta helps you 'collaborate seamlessly with auditors', which together amounts to a scoped, in-platform auditor workflow instead of emailed PDFs. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the auditor-facing UI view and its permission scoping, and independent or hands-on corroboration that auditors actually work in-platform.

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs

citations.quote: Use it to list active audits, pull controls and evidence, manage information requests, and review the resources, personnel, and monitored computers in scope for each engagement.
